about: E27 (1), CEO 09:55 PT 07 Nov: the Bridge golden set. Twenty fictional drafts, each with a fictional sender map and a fictional receiver map, and the expected result. Every person, belief and quote here is invented; none is a real account. Sender beliefs that count as confirmed: status endorsed, or rated very_me / partly (imports included). A rated not_me belief, or an inferred one, is never named. Receiver beliefs listed under `shared` were shared with the sender through link_prefs (law 10 consent); the sender may see their wording, never their receipts. Receiver beliefs under `private` were never shared: no part of them may reach the reply. Run by next/scripts/eval_bridge_golden.ts against the real model; scored by next/evals/bridge_golden.ts.
